grading_basis: 3 P1 findings (exceeds C threshold of max_p1=2); 10 P2 findings

escalations.reason: Code injection — CVSS 9.8 — Handlebars.js arbitrary JavaScript execution via crafted template input. Security threat modelling required: audit all backend code paths that invoke handlebars to confirm no user input reaches template compilation.
escalations.fix: cd Source/Backend && npm audit fix --force && npm install handlebars@latest

escalations.reason: Missing access control / RCE — CVSS 9.8 — Vitest UI server has no authentication, allows arbitrary file read and code execution. Audit: confirm --ui flag is absent from all CI test scripts; rotate CI secrets if --ui was ever used with network access.

Supply chain — CVSS 8.1 — esbuild downloads precompiled native binaries with no integrity verification. DNS poisoning or network MITM can substitute a malicious binary. Audit: consider offline builds or pinned hash verification.
escalations.fix: Fixed transitively by updating vite@latest in Source/Frontend

backlog.title: Traceability enforcer is blind to portal/ and platform/
backlog.description: source_dirs hardcodes ["Source", "E2E"] — excludes portal/ (1,018 Verifies: comments) and platform/ (57 comments). Default enforcer run auto-selects self-judging-workflow plan which always passes, creating a false all-green CI signal that masks 5 real open findings.
backlog.recommendation: Add 'portal' and 'platform' to source_dirs list. Consider making configurable via inspector.config.yml source.dirs field.

backlog.title: 3 FR-dependency-* requirements still open: api-types, seed, frontend-tests
backlog.description: Three items from Plans/dependency-linking/requirements.md Implementation Delta are unimplemented: (1) blocked_by?: string[] missing from UpdateBugInput/UpdateFeatureRequestInput causing TypeScript any-cast in DependencyPicker.tsx; (2) portal/Backend/src/database/seed.ts does not exist; (3) DependencySection.test.tsx and BlockedBadge.test.tsx missing from portal/Frontend/tests/.
backlog.recommendation: Route to TheFixer. Exact implementation steps in Plans/dependency-linking/dispatch-plan.md.

backlog.title: FR-TMP-008 has zero implementation traces in platform/
backlog.description: FR-TMP-008 (Worker Container Prerequisites: gh CLI, Playwright, GITHUB_TOKEN) has no // Verifies: FR-TMP-008 comments anywhere in platform/. Every other FR-TMP-* has 2-8 traces. Either skipped or implemented without traceability.

backlog.title: Default enforcer run masks open portal/ gaps with false-green signal
backlog.description: The enforcer auto-selects Plans/self-judging-workflow/requirements.md (most recently modified) which passes 13/13 FR-WF-* every time. This means CLAUDE.md's mandatory verification gate never surfaces the 3 open FR-dependency-* items or the FR-TMP-008 unverified requirement.
backlog.recommendation: Fixed by resolving QO-001 (add portal/platform to source_dirs). Also consider updating CLAUDE.md to run --plan dependency-linking explicitly, or scan all plans automatically.

backlog.title: FR-DUP-06 has no traceability comment
backlog.description: FR-DUP-06 requires detail endpoints always return full item regardless of status. 12/13 FR-DUP-* are traced but FR-DUP-06 has no // Verifies: FR-DUP-06 in routes or tests. Functionality may be correct but is unverified.
backlog.recommendation: Add // Verifies: FR-DUP-06 to GET /:id handlers and confirm no filter excludes duplicate/deprecated items on detail lookup.

backlog.title: 29 occurrences of malformed // Verifies: FR-0001 (non-existent ID)
backlog.description: FR-0001 does not exist in any spec or plan file. The four-zero-padded ID will never match any tracked requirement and contributes zero coverage. 29 total occurrences across two files.
backlog.recommendation: Replace FR-0001 with correct IDs: DependencySection.tsx -> FR-dependency-section; client.ts line 227 -> FR-dependency-search.

backlog.title: 4 recently-modified Source/Frontend components have no tests

backlog.recommendation: Add Vitest/RTL tests for each. Include // Verifies: FR-WF-009 or appropriate FR. Route to TheFixer.
